text_block_list.text:
Out on the Academy track, I spotted Symboli Rudolf
and Narita Brian instructing some underclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Well, that concludes the explanation.
Keep the form I just taught you in mind,
and make the absolute most of your running style's strengths.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Yes, President!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Did you really need me tagging along for this?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha... Standard textbook guidance must have
been rather dull for you, Brian.
However, your turn begins from here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone. Next, let us try feeling
the run with your instincts rather than overthinking it.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Brian here will serve as your coach.
Give it your all, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Yes! Please take care of us!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey. You know this already, but
I don't know the first thing about 'instructing'.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is quite fine.
I want you to do it your own way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't blame me for whatever happens, then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey. You lots...
Just run for now. At full throttle.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, ah, yes!
Um, are there any key points we should focus on...?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Cut the logic. I have only one demand...
Don't show me a half-assed run.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Eep?! Y-Yes, ma'am!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph.
I don't know how to hold back—Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Haah!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl C
text_block_list.text:
...Waaah?! B-Brian-senpai is chasing
us down with insane momentum!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter, run!!
Struggle with everything you've got!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek...!!
R-Ruuuun for your lives!!

Though the students ran desperately...
they were overtaken one by one, swallowed whole
by Narita Brian's ferocious surge.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *gasp*...!
Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tch, just as I thought.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...No, there is no need for concern.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone. In that practical exercise just now,
was there anyone among you who could run
strictly according to the theory I taught earlier?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Indeed—it is only natural you could not. A real race
is a raging tempest where your opponents' fierce passions swirl.
One rarely has the luxury of running in an ideal textbook fashion.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To fully unleash the skills you have acquired, you first
require an unshakeable 'fighting spirit' that will not yield to any rival.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Fighting spirit... Ah?!
You mean, like what we just felt...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Precisely. Because I wanted you all to understand its importance
even during practice, I had her set an example today.

text_block_list.name: Junior Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
—!
Thank you so much, Brian-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Hmph. Do your best to hang in there.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, so you had all this calculated from the start.
Rudolf... you played me like a fiddle.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Haha, whatever could you mean?
I merely wished to teach them the most crucial element in racing. Indeed—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To run with 'fighting spirit' surging 'straight through' body and mind!
That is the key!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I'm going back.
